import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {

    // ModInt class for dynamic modulus
    public static class ModInt {
        private int v;
        public static int mod;
        public ModInt(long x) {
            long r = x % mod;
            if (r < 0) r += mod;
            v = (int) r;
        }
        public ModInt(int x) {
            this((long) x);
        }
        public ModInt() { this(0); }
        public int val() { return v; }
        public ModInt add(ModInt o) {
            long res = (long) v + o.v;
            if (res >= mod) res -= mod;
            return new ModInt(res);
        }
        public ModInt sub(ModInt o) {
            long res = (long) v - o.v;
            if (res < 0) res += mod;
            return new ModInt(res);
        }
        public ModInt mul(ModInt o) {
            long res = (long) v * o.v % mod;
            return new ModInt(res);
        }
        public ModInt neg() { return new ModInt(-v); }
        public ModInt pow(long e) {
            ModInt x = new ModInt(1);
            ModInt a = this;
            while (e > 0) {
                if ((e & 1) == 1) x = x.mul(a);
                a = a.mul(a);
                e >>= 1;
            }
            return x;
        }
        // extended Euclid for inverse (mod is not necessarily prime)
        public ModInt inv() {
            long a = v, b = mod;
            long u = 1, v = 0;
            while (b != 0) {
                long q = a / b;
                long tmp = a % b;
                a = b;
                b = tmp;
                tmp = u - q * v;
                u = v;
                v = tmp;
            }
            if (u < 0) u += mod / a;
            return new ModInt(u);
        }
        public static void setMod(int m) { mod = m; }
        @Override
        public String toString() { return Integer.toString(v); }
    }

    // pair for (first, second)
    static class Pair {
        ModInt first, second;
        Pair(ModInt a, ModInt b) { first = a; second = b; }
    }

    // fast input
    static class Scanner {
        BufferedReader br;
        StringTokenizer st;
        Scanner(InputStream in) {
            br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(in));
        }
        String next() {
            while (st == null || !st.hasMoreTokens()) {
                try {
                    st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
                } catch (IOException e) {
                    e.printStackTrace();
                }
            }
            return st.nextToken();
        }
        int nextInt() { return Integer.parseInt(next()); }
        long nextLong() { return Long.parseLong(next()); }
    }

    // fast output
    static class Printer {
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        void write(String s) { sb.append(s); }
        void write(int x) { sb.append(x); }
        void write(long x) { sb.append(x); }
        void write(char c) { sb.append(c); }
        void writeln() { sb.append('\n'); }
        void writeln(String s) { sb.append(s).append('\n'); }
        void writeln(int x) { sb.append(x).append('\n'); }
        void writeln(long x) { sb.append(x).append('\n'); }
        void flush() { System.out.print(sb.toString()); sb.setLength(0); }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        Printer pr = new Printer();

        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        int mod = sc.nextInt();
        ModInt.setMod(mod);

        // binomial coefficients C[i][j]
        ModInt[][] C = new ModInt[n+1][n+1];
        C[0][0] = new ModInt(1);
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            C[i][0] = new ModInt(1);
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                C[i][j] = C[i-1][j-1].add(C[i-1][j]);
            }
        }

        // g[i] = i*(i+1)/2 as modint
        ModInt[] g = new ModInt[n+1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            long val = (long) i * (i+1) / 2;
            g[i] = new ModInt(val);
        }

        // f[i] = pair (pattern, sum of madness)
        Pair[] f = new Pair[n+1];
        f[0] = new Pair(new ModInt(1), new ModInt(0));

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            ModInt firstVal = new ModInt(0);
            ModInt secondVal = new ModInt(0);
            for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                // j and (i-1-j)
                ModInt z = f[j].first.mul(f[i-1-j].first).mul(C[i-1][j]);
                firstVal = firstVal.add(z.mul(new ModInt(i+1)));
                secondVal = secondVal.add(z.mul(g[j].add(g[i-1-j])));
                // cross terms
                ModInt cross = f[i-1-j].first.mul(f[j].second).add(f[j].first.mul(f[i-1-j].second));
                cross = cross.mul(C[i-1][j]).mul(new ModInt(i+1));
                secondVal = secondVal.add(cross);
            }
            f[i] = new Pair(firstVal, secondVal);
        }

        // dp[l][i] = pair (first, second) for positions up to l with i something?
        // Actually dp[l][i] is for left boundary l and i components? Let's follow C++ code.
        // dp dimensions (n+2) x (m+1)
        Pair[][] dp = new Pair[n+2][m+1];
        for (int l = 0; l <= n+1; l++) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= m; i++) {
                dp[l][i] = new Pair(new ModInt(0), new ModInt(0));
            }
        }
        dp[0][0] = new Pair(new ModInt(1), new ModInt(0));

        for (int l = 0; l <= n; l++) {
            for (int r = l+1; r <= n+1; r++) {
                int di = r - l - 1;
                for (int i = 0; i + di <= m; i++) {
                    // from dp[l][i] to dp[r][i+di]
                    ModInt z = dp[l][i].first.mul(f[di].first);
                    // combination C[i+di][di]
                    ModInt comb = C[i+di][di];
                    // first part
                    dp[r][i+di].first = dp[r][i+di].first.add(z.mul(comb));
                    // second part
                    ModInt cross = dp[l][i].second.mul(f[di].first).add(dp[l][i].first.mul(f[di].second));
                    dp[r][i+di].second = dp[r][i+di].second.add(cross.mul(comb));
                }
            }
        }

        pr.writeln(dp[n+1][m].second.val());
        pr.flush();
    }
}
